title: BDLLfxC and the 2025 Pa-sparing 6-month
dek: Bedaquiline, delamanid, linezolid, levofloxacin, clofazimine — the WHO 2025 6-month off-ramp when pretomanid is off the table (pregnancy, age <14, no Pa access). Then drop Lfx or CFZ once FQ DST lands.
story: WHO 2025 adds a 6-month regimen of bedaquiline, delamanid, linezolid, levofloxacin, and clofazimine (BDLLfxC) for MDR/RR-TB, aimed at people who cannot take BPaLM — notably pregnancy/breastfeeding, children under 14, or no pretomanid. start all five if FQ DST is unknown; if FQ-S, drop clofazimine (BDLLfx); if FQ-R, drop levofloxacin (BDLC).
This is not “add delamanid to BPaLM.” Pretomanid is absent. Delamanid is a nitroimidazole like Pa but with a different regulatory and pregnancy story. QTc stacking (BDQ+DLM+CFZ+FQ) is the ECG tax.

endTB and BEAT-TB evidence also support modified 9-month oral recipes (BLMZ, BLLfxCZ, BDLLfxZ) as alternatives to longer-than-18-month regimens when FQ-S. WHO ranks BLMZ above BLLfxCZ above BDLLfxZ among those. Do not use DCLLfxZ or DCMZ as 9-month constructs — WHO suggests against.
deepTitle: How to not drown in acronyms
deep: Write the drugs, not just the letters, on the first line of the chart.
Linezolid 600 mg still applies. Delamanid twice-daily dosing is not pretomanid 200 mg daily.
Children: this is one of the reasons BDLLfxC exists. Pediatric DLM/BDQ dosing is weight-banded — use the operational handbook, not adult tablets snapped by eye.
If BDQ or LZD is lost, you are in longer individualised Group A/B/C construction, not a five-letter meme.

visual.caption: Pa-ineligible RR-TB: start BDLLfxC, then prune Lfx or CFZ by FQ DST. This is parallel to BPaLM, not a decoration on it.

example.title: Age 11, RR-TB, FQ pending
example.setup: 11-year-old, Ultra RIF detected, no pretomanid paediatric indication in your NTP, FQ unknown.

steps.title: Not BPaLM by age
steps.body: BPaLM’s evidence and labelling are not this child. BDLLfxC is the 2025 6-month designed for this gap.

steps.title: Start five, then prune
steps.body: Do not delay the whole regimen for gyrA. Drop CFZ or Lfx when the FQ result lands.

steps.title: Weight-band BDQ and DLM
steps.body: Adult 400/200 BDQ schedules are not a 25 kg child. Open the handbook table.

example.takeaway: BDLLfxC is the Pa-free 6-month sibling, not a misspelling of BPaLM.
